notes.title: POLYGON Life 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello gamers, it's been a while without news about updates, but we announce a new improved version of the game, with our owns models, and more content, like more jobs, more food, bigger city, new houses, etc... We would like to publish it at the end of the year, since it requires a full modeling and programming work. We beg you patience because we are a small team and we want to make this game worth it, cause we have a personal love to it.
(If there any mistake with the translation, is because we are spanish and we don't have much knowledge about english) 


A virtual hug.
David, RGNTeam Modeler.
